title: Which substrates a law fails on: the knot, parity and Z3, and a rigid bridge at four values
subject: On which connected cubic substrates the knot, parity and Z3 fail, whether globally, and whether a cycle-composing law can select as the knot does
conclusion: The knot fails exactly on Pfaffian substrates, always globally; parity where perfect matchings are even, never globally; Z3 everywhere, globally exactly at Z3-corank 1. Blurred Z3 on corank-1 substrates both selects (global failures, easy after removing a line, hard in general) and composes like cycles, but its selected spaces are rigid, only ties, while the knot's can keep a knot.
